name: nutricam
description:
See which vitamins and minerals a meal gives you, and which it's missing. Share a meal photo or say what you ate, and NutriCam shows its vitamins and minerals as a share of your daily needs, with the gaps called out, plus calories and macros. Ask about several meals at once to see how they add up. Built on Dietary Reference Intakes, the same targets as the NutriCam iPhone app. Tap Log to keep a running daily total in the NutriCam app.

NutriCam gives estimates, not medical advice.

capabilities: Estimate a meal's vitamins and minerals as % of daily intake
Show the nutrient gaps in a meal or several meals
Show calories, protein, carbs and fat

positive.description: A user asks about specific minerals in a dinner they describe.
positive.prompt: @NutriCam I had salmon, brown rice and spinach for dinner. Does this have enough magnesium and potassium?
positive.expected_behavior: A NutriCam card shows a dial of the meal's vitamins and minerals as % of daily intake, the number of gaps with the lowest ones listed, calories and macros, and a Log button. ChatGPT answers the magnesium and potassium question in text.

positive.description: A user asks which vitamins a described breakfast provides.
positive.prompt: @NutriCam I had oatmeal with blueberries and almond milk for breakfast. What vitamins am I getting from it?
positive.expected_behavior: A NutriCam card for the breakfast shows its vitamins and minerals as % of daily intake. ChatGPT names the main vitamins it provides.

positive.description: A user lists three separate foods eaten today.
positive.prompt: @NutriCam I've had a latte, a chicken wrap and a protein bar today.
positive.expected_behavior: analyze_meal is called once with three meals. One NutriCam card shows a '3 meals' dial with the combined gaps, a Log button per meal, the combined calories and macros, and a 'Log all 3' button.

positive.description: A user asks for the protein in a common dish.
positive.prompt: @NutriCam Roughly how much protein is in a chicken caesar wrap?
positive.expected_behavior: A NutriCam card shows the wrap's nutrients with protein in the macros line. ChatGPT states the estimated protein in grams.

positive.description: A user asks what is missing from a meal.
positive.prompt: @NutriCam Here's my lunch: a turkey sandwich on white bread with potato chips. What's missing from it nutritionally?
positive.expected_behavior: A NutriCam card leads with the meal's nutrient gaps. ChatGPT names the gaps and suggests foods that would fill them.

negative.description: An unrelated general question; NutriCam should not be called.
A workout logging request; NutriCam tracks food only and should not be called.
negative.prompt: @NutriCam Log my 5k run from this morning.

negative.description: A symptom question with no meal; NutriCam should not diagnose or be called, and ChatGPT should suggest seeing a doctor.
negative.prompt: @NutriCam I feel tired all the time. Do I have an iron deficiency?

publication.release_notes: First release. Estimates a meal's vitamins and minerals against daily reference intakes, highlights the gaps, and shows calories and macros, for one meal or several. Log opens NutriCam on the App Store. Read-only: nothing is saved and no account is needed.
